customer_message.subject: Owner's son wants our flat
customer_message.body:
Name: Jonah Achterberg
Address: Zelgweg 69, 4900 Langenthal, 4.5 rooms
Landlord: Immo Jura Verwaltungen AG

Message:
During the annual flat inspection last week, the owner's agent told me that the owner's son is coming back from abroad and will move into our flat, and that the lease will be ended "for the end of July". So far I have received no written termination, just that remark.

There has never been any issue with our rent, we have always paid on time.

If this really happens, we need more time than that. I care for my father, who has dementia and lives two streets away, our older child starts kindergarten in Langenthal in August, and the vacancy rate here is close to zero. We would want an extension of the lease.

I'd like to know what our position is and what we should do while we wait.

Jonah Achterberg
